# Bundled libraries

Kept in the repo (not loaded from a CDN) so creating quotes and invoices works offline.

- `jspdf.umd.min.js`: jsPDF 4.2.1, MIT licence, https://github.com/parallax/jsPDF
- `pdf-font.js`: Liberation Sans Regular and Bold, subset to Latin and Latin Extended-A (covers Maltese letters), SIL Open Font License 1.1, https://github.com/liberationfonts/liberation-fonts
